chunks: A number of our companions, from Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, from Ibn Faḍḍāl, from al-Rayyān ibn al-Ṣalt, who said:
I heard Abā al-Ḥasan al-Riḍā عليه السلام saying, and he was asked about al-Qāʾim. So he said: “His body will not be seen, nor will his name be mentioned.”

key_terms.الرِّضَا: the title of Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام
key_terms.الْحَسَنِ: part of the kunyah of Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام, Abā al-Ḥasan
key_terms.الْقَائِمِ: the Rising Imam, the awaited Imam from the Ahl al-Bayt

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام say about seeing and naming al-Qāʾim?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a statement from Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام concerning al-Qāʾim, indicating a condition in which he is not publicly seen and his name is not openly mentioned. It reflects the concealed state associated with the awaited Imam and the restriction on naming him directly.
